envelope.description: Implement deriveReceiptIdentity, verifyContentIdentityMatch, and s3's new error/report types

body.title: Implement deriveReceiptIdentity, verifyContentIdentityMatch, and s3's new error/report types
body.summary: Built and passed (commit 78f2e8441). Adds ContentIdentityMismatchError and SecurityModelUnavailableError, the in-memory SecurityReviewReport interface, deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity), and verifyContentIdentityMatch(repoPath, targets, advisoryEvidence).
acceptanceChecks: deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity) returns {epicHash, storyId:'s1'} where epicHash is exactly 16 lowercase hex characters derived deterministically from contentIdentity; the SAME contentIdentity always re-derives the identical pair, a different one derives a different pair
the derived identity round-trips through a REAL persistVerificationReceipt + readReceiptRecord call without being rejected by the storage layer's own id-shape checks
verifyContentIdentityMatch resolves silently when computeContentIdentity(repoPath, targets) === advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity and advisoryEvidence.contentStable is true
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when the recomputed identity does not match advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when contentStable is false even though the identity strings match

tests.name: deriveReceiptIdentity: same contentIdentity re-derives the identical pair; a different identity derives a different pair
deriveReceiptIdentity's output round-trips through a REAL persistVerificationReceipt + readReceiptRecord call without being rejected by the storage layer
verifyContentIdentityMatch: resolves on a match with contentStable:true; throws on identity mismatch; throws on contentStable:false even when identity matches
